That sounds like a frustrating way to end an event, and I'm sorry your guests had to deal with that.

I can't make any commitments around compensation or liability myself — let me get our events manager to look into what happened and follow up with you today by email. Can you confirm the date of your event and the name it was booked under so they can pull the details?
